items.title: Module.__setattr__ bypasses _assign() for underscore-prefixed attributes, breaking simulation
items.description: Module.__setattr__ bypasses _assign() for underscore-prefixed attributes, breaking simulation

notes.msg: When a Register is named with underscore prefix (e.g. self._prev), Module.__setattr__ falls through to object.__setattr__ which replaces the Signal with a plain int. This silently breaks simulation. Workaround: use non-underscore names for all registers. Fix: __setattr__ should check for Signal before the underscore check, or use a different mechanism.
Fixed: __setattr__ now checks for Signal before the underscore prefix check. Underscore-prefixed registers (e.g. self._prev) now correctly use _assign() instead of being replaced. All 525 tests pass.
